deadline.value: International applicants apply by December 15, 2026 for September 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: International Deadline Fall September December 15 December 15

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No supervisor needed before applying; you can list up to three preferred supervisors without asking them first.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary to find a potential supervisor before you apply to this program.

funding.value: PhD students are normally funded for 4 years at tuition plus CAD 20,000/year; all applicants are considered automatically. Some funding needs an 80% admission average and lab-instructor or marking duties.
funding.quote: All applicants to both the Computer Science and the Applied Computing graduate program are automatically considered for financial support. | Ph.D. students are normally funded for 4 years (the expected program length) at a rate that covers the cost of tuition per year at the time of admission plus $20,000/year.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree (70%+) is required for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in an academic discipline relevant to the proposed field of study

toefl_min.value: Computer Science requires TOEFL 4.5 (no section below 4.0), IELTS 7.0 (no band below 6.5) or Duolingo 120 (no section below 115), above the university minimum.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum TOEFL score of 4.5 (no score below 4.0); or a minimum IELTS score of 7.0 (no score below 6.5); or a minimum DuoLingo score of 120 (no score lower than 115).

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with no band below 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum IELTS score of 7.0 (no score below 6.5)

english_waiver.value: Computer Science does not use the WHED list and does not accept medium-of-instruction letters, so Indian applicants should expect to take a test; exemptions are only possible in certain circumstances by asking the department.
english_waiver.quote: the Department of Computer Science does not use the WHED database to exempt students if the primary language of instruction at their previous institution was in English, and the Department of Computer Science does not accept letters from universities stating the medium of instruction is English. However, test exemptions may be possible in certain circumstances
